content:
Nina: Heads-up  new Staff ML Infra starts Mon 9am PT. Need a compact week0 agenda, a candidate-facing one-pager, and a manager 30/60/90 checklist I can hand to the hiring manager. Priya can you draft?
Priya: Sure. Quick confirms: buddy? laptop imaging? NDA?
Nina: Buddy Arturo mornings. IT said laptop can be imaged Fri if Ben gets the asset tag today. Legal wants NDA before dataset access.
Ben: Ill queue imaging + Okta + Slack auto-invite. Please open a GH org invite ticket and k8s namespace request.
Arturo: I can run morning pairing 09:30-10:00 PT first 2 weeks. Will add a short "how to run tests" doc to the invite.
Priya: Draft week0 (very short):
Mon AM: welcome + workstation/account handoff + Slack intros
Mon PM: team demo + repo pairing (get dev env green)
Tue: code tour + assign 1 micro-task (PR)
Wed: runbooks, observability (Grafana/Stackdriver) + security/NDA check
Thu: deploy workflow + smoke canary with buddy
Fri: 30m manager review + buddy retro + plan for week2
Priya: Pre-provision checklist to IT/Infra: laptop image, Okta, Slack invite, GH org + repo write, CI access, k8s namespace + service account (canary role), read-only prod metrics + Grafana share, Redwood Console dev org.
Priya: Candidate one-pager (single paragraph): clear expectations for 30/60/90, key contacts (buddy, manager, infra owner), NDA link, and what success looks like (env ready; 12 small PRs; owning a non-peak deploy by 60d).
Priya: Manager 30/60/90 (concise bullet list):
- Week0: accounts confirmed, daily 15m check-ins, 3 micro-tasks assigned
- 30d: env ready, 2 PRs merged, buddy feedback collected
- 60d: owns deploy for a service in a non-peak window; demonstrates incident-debug steps
- 90d: independent deploys; leads a short tech review; proposes 1 perf/cost improvement tied to OKR
Nina: Also include a tiny "Manager how-to" blurb: daily 15m, explicit acceptance criteria for micro-tasks, 30m end-of-week review, mid-30d formative check.
legal-bot: NDA requirement noted. Link: https://redwood.example.com/nda/1847509999
people-ops-bot: Onboarding checklist created: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/1847509999
Ben: Opening infra tickets now; will tag canary-only deploy role.
Arturo: Confirmed calendar invites. I'll prepare a "first 48h checklist" for pairing.
Priya: I'll post the candidate one-pager and manager checklist here for review in ~2 hours. Nina, ping me if you want any specific phrasing for the hiring manager email.
Nina: Great, thanks team. Once Priya posts I'll sign off and hiring manager will send to candidate. :thumbsup:
